notes: Table 7 (UK voluntary IFRS adoption, external-validity analysis), firm-FE column: reghdfe for_share_yr ifrs_firm ifrs_post $controls1, absorb(id fyear) vce(cluster id) keepsingle (002_code/007d_UK_Analysis_Table7.do); ifrs_firm is collinear with firm FE and omitted by reghdfe (o.ifrs_firm), so it is not a control. Data: shipped UK_shrhldr_data_WD_250730.dta (real Orbis-derived firm-years, anonymized ids, winsorized; not on the synthetic list), 8,056 private UK firms, fiscal years 2014-2023 (the README's 2013-2017 is outdated), unbalanced panel. Treatment ifrs_post = ifrs_firm x post_new, absorbing by construction (IFRS status carried forward), no switch-offs. gvar g_full = first fiscal year with ifrs_post = 1 computed on the full Table 7 sample (prepared file ~/did_packages/_work/mnsc.2024.08765/uk_table7_prepared.csv, which also carries cem_matched and psm_support saved from a work-directory copy of the authors' do-file run in Stata MP 16; D = 1(fyear >= g_full) equals ifrs_post row by row). Full sample: 10 adoption cohorts 2014-2023; the 2014 cohort (393 firms) is treated from the first sample year (always treated), 747 adopters are treated in their own first observed year; 6,200 never-treated firms (incl. 100 ever-IFRS firms whose IFRS years are outside the sample). Controls $controls1 = size lev dsales roa_lagat neg_dsales neg_roa, all time-varying, entered linearly as published. Published coefficient from the authors' 003_tables/007d_UK_Analysis_Table7_DiD_UK.txt (no PDF or article text in the project); the table reports t statistics, so published_se = coef / t. R/fixest and Stata (installed reghdfe) reproduce coefficient, SE and N exactly. Excluded Table 7 columns: 1, 4, 7, 10, 13 (ifrs_firm only, no post-treatment regressor); 2, 5, 8, 11, 14 (industry-by-year FE without firm FE: unit-FE rule); 6 and 15 (entropy-balancing aweights: reweighting rule). in_abstract_intro unknown (no abstract or text); Table 7 is a secondary external-validity table.
